question_text: In an experiment studying phototropism, students grew bean plants in labeled cardboard milk cartons. Afterward, the plants and soil were properly discarded. Which instruction line BEST conserves the remaining resources?
choices: A: recycle the markers, reuse the milk cartons
B: reuse the markers, discard the milk cartons
C: discard the markers, reuse the milk cartons
D: reuse the markers, recycle the milk cartons
